verdict.rationale: Langfuse offers self-hosting (Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform) which gives users infrastructure-level control over their own data, implying they can manage retention/deletion themselves, but there is no explicit documentation of a retention policy setting, deletion API, or data lifecycle management feature in the evidence pack. Missing for 10: explicit retention/deletion API or UI controls, documented data retention policy, GDPR-specific deletion tooling, and any independent confirmation that these controls work as described.
